programme.title: Detective Chinatown [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: An action-packed comedy from the producer of Lost In Thailand and Jian Bing Man, Detective Chinatown (Tang Ren Jie Tan An) follows Qin Feng and his second cousin, Tang Ren, Chinatown's top detective, as they investigate a bizarre murder.

programme.title: Tazza: The Hidden Card [English Dub]
programme.desc: Dae-gil, a young man with natural born talents in gambling, makes a dazzling debut as a gambler and gets reunited with his first love, Mi-na. However, Dae-gil soon becomes the scapegoat of betrayal and conspiracy and is forced to be on the run. Dae-gil plans to get revenge and prepares for one big, fated game for Mi-na who has been helping him every step of the way.

programme.title: The Tooth and the Nail [English Sub]
programme.desc: In Seoul, a soon after acquiring independence from Japanese occupation, two men met and there came the sound of six shots firing. The police arrests Nam Do-jin, the wealthiest man as a suspect for the murder of a driver named Choi Seung-man. However, all they could find was a burnt body, blood spots, and chopped off fingers. As the trial goes on, it becomes more obvious that the murder had been meticulously planned out and carried out.

programme.title: The 12th Suspect [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In this acclaimed whodunnit thriller, a bohemian teahouse becomes an interrogation room when the murder of a prominent poet brings a zealous detective to investigate--and he's marked every single customer as a potential suspect.

programme.title: You Will Die in 6 Hours [English Sub]
programme.desc: Jung-yoon was approached by a random stranger named Jun-woo, who told her she'd be dead in six hours. As she follows him for answers, she begins to question whether he's her savior or the one trying to put her in danger.

programme.title: The Terror Live [English Dub]
programme.desc: A newsman discovers he's been rigged with a bomb after he has an exclusive interview with a terrorist who blew up a bridge.

programme.title: The Divine Fury [English Dub]
programme.desc: Champion fighter Yong-hu seeks aid from a priest when strange wounds appear on his palms, leading to a battle against evil.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Shanghai [English Dub]
programme.desc: A laborer moves to Shanghai in the hope of becoming rich. But ends up using his kung fu skills to survive. Remake of The Boxer From Shantung.

programme.title: The Witch: Subversion [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ja-yoon enters a TV contest to help her family, but mysterious figures disrupt her life, revealing secrets from her forgotten past.

programme.title: The Big Swindle [English Sub]
programme.desc: Five best swindlers in Korea form a team to rob Korea Bank, the biggest and most difficult bank to rob. Even as they work together for their common goal, each swindler has a secret agenda and does not trust others. After the bank is robbed, the police learn that the anonymous caller who helped them catch some members is a girlfriend of one of the swindlers and that she might be holding the key to solving the mysterious disappearance of money.

programme.title: Secretly Greatly [English Dub]
programme.desc: A group of spies called the 5446 Corps were trained since their youth by North Korea to unify Korea. They are ambitiously dispatched to South Korea, where each disguises himself as a fool, an aspiring singer, and a high school student. One day, their mundane lives are turned upside down when a "secret and great" mission is suddenly assigned to them.

programme.title: RAGING FIRE [English Dub]
programme.desc: Cheung Sung-bong is a highly respected cop with a long history of success in dangerous cases. However, his past soon comes back to haunt him when a former protégé resurfaces, seeking revenge.
